updates.title: Shop stations work on qb-target
changes: Each station is one target with every bench's options, so Fit the LEDs shows on qb-target.
Opening the phone with a big speaker in hand puts the speaker away.

updates.title: Music for jobs and VIPs
changes: General: Music VIPs and VIP Check let a VIP script's players play music.
Other scripts can allow players with setMusicAccess or an ACE.

updates.title: Cleaner phone queue, no item errors
changes: 17mov Phone: the queue no longer shows its swipe buttons behind every song.
Wasabi: no more unknown item errors for the old Light and Green speakers.

updates.title: Songs play for every player
changes: Songs YouTube blocks in a player's country no longer go silent for them.
A PC clock set wrong no longer sends songs to YouTube's player.

updates.title: Shop props stay visible inside
changes: Speakers, kiosks and screens in the shop no longer vanish once you walk in.

updates.title: Apex Phone support
changes: Speaker Connect works on Apex Phone. GG Lib adds the app automatically.
Needs gg_lib 1.0.25.

updates.title: Phone app follows the Music Jobs
changes: With Job Needed to Play Music on, players without a Music Job cannot open Speaker Connect.
Music Jobs now starts as simmetsound.

updates.title: Job needed to play music
changes: Job Needed to Play Music (General, off by default): only the Music Jobs, dj to start, play, change or add music.
Everyone else still hears it.

updates.title: 17mov Phone support
changes: Speaker Connect works on 17mov Phone. GG Lib adds the app automatically.
Needs gg_lib 1.0.20.

updates.title: Lighter speakers and car tablets
changes: Nothing runs while no speaker or tablet car is near, and the car map with a route draws far less.
Players can turn speakers off for themselves with /speakers.

updates.title: Speaker System optimizations
changes: Car tablets show a still screen to people outside the car, so nearby PCs stop drawing them. The music sounds the same.
Setting: Live Screens Outside the Car.

updates.title: Works on qs-inventory and more
changes: Speaker items now work on qs-inventory and every other inventory gg_lib supports.
Needs gg_lib 1.0.18 or newer.

updates.title: Linked volume, yPhone and emoji fixes
changes: Linked speakers turn up and down together, the app stays on yPhone after a restart and emoji song titles save.
Car tablets are much lighter on FPS.

updates.title: Shop works on any game build
changes: The shop's computer desk, TV stand and coffee table now ship with the props, so the shop works on game build 3095 and newer.

updates.title: QBCore speaker pick-up fix
changes: Fixed an oversight on QBCore where a picked-up speaker dropped back to the ground a second later.
It now stays in hand until you set it down or put it away.

updates.title: Speaker System is here
changes: Speakers, stereos, beam and strobe lights and car dash tablets with a subwoofer, all played from the Speaker Connect phone app.
Needs gg_lib 1.0.13 or newer.
